tools.name: verify_carrier
tools.title: Verify local evidence carrier
tools.description: Verify one local carrier JSON file under the configured root. Returns identity and rights-aware export disposition, never market advice.

path.description: Carrier JSON path, relative to the allowed root or absolute within it.

evaluated_at.description: Optional policy evaluation clock as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. The current UTC time is recorded when omitted.

tools.name: project_carrier
tools.title: Project verified evidence carrier
tools.description: Verify one local carrier and project it to a bounded transport format. Restricted, unsafe, or expired payloads remain blocked or redacted by policy.

path.description: Carrier JSON path, relative to the allowed root or absolute within it.

evaluated_at.description: Optional policy evaluation clock as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. The current UTC time is recorded when omitted.

tools.name: verify_fleet_brief
tools.title: Verify local LiquiLens fleet brief
tools.description: Verify one local, content-addressed fleet brief under the configured root. Replays the exact recorded evaluation clock without fetching or mutating data.

path.description: Fleet brief JSON path, relative to the allowed root or absolute within it.

evaluated_at.description: Required RFC 3339 UTC clock ending in Z; it must match the brief.

tools.name: verify_trade_safety_receipt
tools.title: Verify local hash-only trade-safety receipt
tools.description: Verify one local order-bound receipt under the configured root at an explicit clock. This v1 tool accepts no authentication secrets, so HMAC receipts fail closed and require tenant-local verification. It never fetches market data, recommends, or executes an order.

path.description: Receipt JSON path, relative to the allowed root or absolute within it.

evaluated_at.description: Required verification clock as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
